lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the pectoral fin. These blobs are arranged in approximately four identifiable horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns, following the natural curvature of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are present, intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs. The centroids of the circular high-luminance nodes are primarily positioned within these vertical intensity bands, forming a visible lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible across the mid-to-upper flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient consisting of a high-pixel-value top edge and a low-pixel-value shadow immediately below.

other_distinctive_markers: A high concentration of smaller, high-luminance blobs is visible on the distal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the main lateral flank.
